xmldoc.short_description: Ends the run at the end of the step where its input first becomes nonzero.

param_output_item.param_description: No output ports (this block has none).

description.p: Ends the run at the end of the step where its input first becomes nonzero.

Stops the simulation at the end of the step where its input first becomes nonzero, by setting SimCtx::stopRequested (honored by both the fixed-step and the solver loops). Typically driven by a comparison or interval-test block to stop on a condition. One input, no output; native only.
Registered in the AFTER_STEP phase so it observes each step's settled outputs before deciding to stop.

tr.td: Numeric signal read by the block.

description.p: This block has no output ports.

ul.li: AFTER_STEP: if any input element != 0, set stopRequested = true.
